title: Dog Groomer Minneapolis | Mobile Pet Grooming Twin Cities, MN | Wagmore Co

facts.fact: Wagmore Co states it is rated 5 stars on Google (vendor's own claim; no review count given on the page).
facts.quote: We’re proud to be rated 5 stars on Google for our pawsitively perfect grooming experiences.

facts.fact: Wagmore Co typically services dogs up to 80 lbs, and larger dogs are considered based on groomer approval.
facts.quote: Wagmore Co typically services dogs up to 80 lbs, with larger dogs considered based on groomer approval.

facts.fact: Wagmore Co states it provides mobile dog grooming throughout the west metro Minneapolis area and North Loop.
facts.quote: Wagmore Co provides mobile dog grooming throughout the west metro Minneapolis area and North Loop

facts.fact: Wagmore Co lists these named communities in its service area: Wayzata, Minnetonka, Eden Prairie, Edina, Plymouth, St. Louis Park, Excelsior, Maple Grove, Hopkins, Deephaven, plus nearby communities.
facts.quote: Wayzata, Minnetonka, Eden Prairie, Edina, Plymouth, St. Louis Park, Excelsior, Maple Grove, Hopkins, Deephaven and nearby communities

facts.fact: Wagmore Co states its services include full-service dog grooming, dog bathing, deshedding treatments, nail trimming, sanitary trims, teeth brushing, paw pad trimming, brush-outs, and haircut services, performed at the customer's home.
facts.quote: We offer full-service dog grooming, dog bathing, deshedding treatments, nail trimming, sanitary trims, teeth brushing, paw pad trimming, brush-outs, and haircut services

facts.fact: Wagmore Co states its grooming is done in fully equipped mobile grooming vans that come to the customer's home.
facts.quote: Our fully equipped grooming vans come directly to your home

facts.fact: Wagmore Co states it grooms popular breeds including Goldendoodles, Bernedoodles, Labradoodles, Poodles, Golden Retrievers, Australian Shepherds, Cavalier King Charles Spaniels, and Shih Tzus.
facts.quote: We groom many popular breeds including Goldendoodles, Bernedoodles, Labradoodles, Poodles, Golden Retrievers, Australian Shepherds, Cavalier King Charles Spaniels, Shih Tzus, and more.

facts.fact: Wagmore Co states its prices are not shown on this page; it directs visitors to a separate Services page for pricing.
facts.quote: Learn more about our mobile dog grooming services, dog bathing, deshedding treatments, and pricing on our Services page.

facts.fact: Wagmore Co states it is a proud groomer for M Health Fairview, University of Minnesota Masonic Children's Hospital Facility Dogs, and Ronald McDonald House Charities House Dog.
facts.quote: Proud Groomers for M Health Fairview University of Minnesota Masonic Children’s Hospital Facility Dogs and Ronald McDonald House Charities House Dog
